This practice is not just incompetent; it is dangerous. As an 87-year-old disabled patient, I made a simple, lawful request for my own medical records for an urgent legal matter.

Instead of help, I was met with months of obstruction and discrimination from the Practice Manager, Andrea Sollitt. They initially denied I was a patient, then insisted on an impossible "in-person" attendance despite being told I was abroad for medical treatment and have now failed to provide my records even after I complied with every one of their unreasonable and onerous demands.

Their actions have caused me significant distress and have directly harmed my ability to present my case at a Tribunal. This practice has demonstrated a shocking lack of care and a complete disregard for its legal duties to disabled and elderly patients. Their governance is a failure from the top down. I have been forced to escalate formal complaints to the NHS ICB, the CQC and the Information Commissioner.

Do not entrust your care or the care of your elderly relatives to this
